## What Makes AQUAVO Unique

Before AQUAVO, Iraqi aquarium hobbyists had to rely on scattered local pet shops with limited product selection and no online presence. AQUAVO solves this problem by offering a curated collection of original aquarium products with 5,000 IQD delivery within 24 hours across Iraq.

## Product Categories (Detailed)

### Aquarium Tanks (أحواض زجاجية)
Glass and acrylic aquariums in all sizes from nano tanks (10L) to large display tanks (500L+). Includes rimless, framed, and curved designs. Complete starter kits also available with filter, heater, and lighting included.

### Filters (فلاتر)
Internal filters, external canister filters, hang-on-back filters, and sponge filters from brands like Eheim, Fluval, and SunSun. Suitable for freshwater setups from 20L to 1000L+.

### Heaters (سخانات)
Submersible, adjustable aquarium heaters with thermostat control. Available in 25W to 500W for tanks of all sizes. Essential for tropical fish in Iraq's variable climate.

### LED Lighting (إضاءة LED)
Planted tank lights, standard aquarium lights, and color-enhancing LED fixtures. Full spectrum options for photosynthesis support in planted tanks.

### Fish Food (أغذية أسماك)
Premium flakes, pellets, granules, freeze-dried, and frozen foods for all fish types. Includes specialized formulas for cichlids, bettas, goldfish, tetras, and bottom feeders.

### Water Treatments (علاجات مياه)
Dechlorinators, beneficial bacteria starters, pH adjusters, water conditioners, and fish medications. Includes treatments for common diseases like ich (white spot), fin rot, fungal infections, and parasites.

### Artificial Plants (نباتات صناعية)
Artificial silk and plastic plants for low-maintenance aquarium decoration. Selected for natural appearance, easy cleaning, and aquarium-safe use.

### Decorations (ديكورات)
Natural rocks (dragon stone, seiryu stone), driftwood (Mopani, Malaysian), artificial caves, ruins, and themed backgrounds. Carefully selected to be aquarium-safe.

### Substrates (ركائز)
Aquarium gravel in various colors, natural sand, active planted tank soil (ADA-style), and volcanic substrate. Includes nutrient-rich options for planted tanks.

### Air Pumps & Accessories (مضخات هواء)
Air pumps, air stones, airline tubing, check valves, and bubble decorations. Multiple sizes for tanks from 20L to 500L+.

### Aquarium Tools (أدوات أحواض)
Nets, siphons, cleaning tools, test kits, and practical accessories for aquarium setup and maintenance.

### Complete Starter Kits (أطقم كاملة للمبتدئين)
Everything a beginner needs: tank, filter, heater, LED light, substrate, dechlorinator, fish food, and a printed care guide — all in one package at a discounted price.

### Returns & Exchanges

**Q: How do I return a product?**
A: Contact us via WhatsApp or phone with your order number and reason. We offer free pickup within Baghdad.

**Q: When will I receive my refund?**
A: Cash payments — refunded immediately upon pickup. Bank transfers — within 3-7 business days.

**Q: Can I exchange instead of return?**
A: Yes, free exchanges are available. You can swap for an equal-value product or pay/receive the difference.

**Q: What if my product arrives damaged?**
A: Take clear photos within 24 hours and contact us. We provide full replacement or refund with our apologies.

### Fish Care

**Q: How do I choose the right aquarium?**
A: Use our tank calculator at aquavoiq.com/calculators. Generally, allocate at least 2 liters per centimeter of fish length. Larger tanks are easier to maintain and more stable.

**Q: How often should I change the water?**
A: Change 20-30% of the water weekly. Always treat new water with dechlorinator and match the temperature to the tank water.

**Q: What is the ideal water temperature?**
A: Most tropical fish need 24-28°C. Goldfish prefer 18-24°C. Check specific requirements for each species on our fish encyclopedia.

**Q: How often should I feed my fish?**
A: Twice daily, only what they consume within 2-3 minutes. Overfeeding is more dangerous than underfeeding and pollutes the water.

**Q: Why do my fish keep dying despite caring for them?**
A: Common causes include: not cycling the tank before adding fish, changing too much water at once, or overcrowding. Contact us for free diagnosis.

### Products & Quality

**Q: Are the products authentic?**
A: Yes, all products are 100% genuine, sourced directly from manufacturers with authenticity guarantees.

**Q: Is there a warranty on equipment?**
A: Yes — filters and pumps: 1 year; heaters and LED lights: 6 months; tanks: 1 year leak guarantee.

**Q: Where do the fish come from?**
A: From trusted local farms and certified importers. All fish undergo quarantine before sale to ensure health.

**Q: Do you have beginner-friendly products?**
A: Yes, we have a dedicated beginner section with complete starter kits, easy-care fish, and free care guides.

**Q: Can I order a product that's not in stock?**
A: Absolutely. Tell us what you need and we'll source it within 1-2 weeks. No minimum for special orders.

## Aquarium Knowledge Base

### Setting Up Your First Aquarium (Beginner Guide Summary)
Setting up a freshwater aquarium in Iraq requires 6 key steps: (1) Choose a tank of at least 60 liters — larger tanks are easier to maintain and more forgiving of mistakes. (2) Install the filter, heater, and LED lighting according to manufacturer instructions. (3) Add substrate (gravel or planted soil) and decorations like rocks and driftwood. (4) Fill with dechlorinated water slowly to avoid disturbing the setup. (5) Run the filter and heater for 5-7 days before adding any fish — this allows beneficial bacteria to colonize. (6) Start with 2-3 small, hardy fish and gradually add more each week.

### Water Quality in Iraq
Iraqi tap water typically contains chlorine and chloramine that are harmful to fish. Always use a dechlorinator when adding tap water to your aquarium. Baghdad water tends to be moderately hard (GH 8-12), which suits many popular freshwater species like livebearers (guppies, mollies, platies) and African cichlids. For soft-water species like tetras and discus, a water softener or RO system may be needed.

### Popular Fish Species in Iraq
The most popular ornamental fish among Iraqi hobbyists include: Guppies (الجوبي) — colorful, easy to breed, ideal for beginners; Betta/Siamese Fighting Fish (البيتا) — vibrant colors, must be kept alone; Goldfish (السمكة الذهبية) — classic choice, needs cooler water; Neon Tetras (النيون تيترا) — schooling fish, beautiful in groups; Angelfish (أسماك الملائكة) — graceful, needs taller tanks; Corydoras (الكوري) — peaceful bottom cleaners; Mollies (المولي) — hardy, adaptable; and various African and American Cichlids (السيكلد) — colorful but can be aggressive.

### Common Fish Diseases in Iraq
The most common fish diseases encountered by Iraqi hobbyists are: Ich/White Spot Disease (مرض النقطة البيضاء) — white spots on body and fins, treated with temperature increase and medication; Fin Rot (تعفن الزعانف) — ragged, deteriorating fins, often caused by poor water quality; Fungal Infections (الفطريات) — cotton-like growths, treated with antifungal medication; Swim Bladder Disease (مرض المثانة الهوائية) — fish floating or sinking abnormally, often related to diet; and Columnaris (العمودي) — white patches and frayed fins. AQUAVO offers free disease diagnosis via WhatsApp — send us a photo of your fish.
